tuning.intro: Guided calibration wizards. Pick one below.

pa.title: Pressure Advance
pa.commandHint: Send it just before the print (or add it to your test model's start g-code); PA ramps up the tower as it prints.

retraction.title: Retraction
retraction.commandHint: Send it just before the print (or add it to your test model's start g-code); retraction length ramps up the tower as it prints. Needs [firmware_retraction] configured.

temp.title: Temperature
temp.commandHint: Send it just before the print (or add it to your test model's start g-code); the target steps once per band as the tower rises, giving the hotend time to settle.

overview.title: What is Pressure Advance?
overview.body: PA compensates for pressure lag in the nozzle, sharpening corners and reducing ooze and bulging. Each filament has its own best value.

workflow.title: How the wizards work
workflow.body: Plan a tuning tower, print it (the value ramps as it rises), read off the cleanest height, then apply the matching value. Save it to printer.cfg to keep it.

retraction.title: What is retraction?
retraction.body: Retraction pulls filament back on travel moves to stop oozing and stringing. Too little leaves strings; too much can cause clogs or gaps. This wizard tunes the firmware retraction length.

temperature.title: What is a temperature tower?
temperature.body: A temperature tower prints the same shape at stepped nozzle temperatures so you can pick the one with the best layer adhesion, surface finish, and least stringing for your filament.

pressureAdvance.def: A Klipper setting that adjusts extrusion ahead of speed changes for crisper corners.

tuningTower.def: A tall print where TUNING_TOWER steadily changes a parameter with height so you can pick the best layer.

firmwareRetraction.def: Klipper's [firmware_retraction] feature: G10/G11 retract and unretract handled by the printer, tunable live with SET_RETRACTION.

temperatureTower.def: A test print divided into bands, each held at a different nozzle temperature, to find a filament's best printing temperature.
